# using-git-worktrees: PR-head home for acme/widget#12

I'm using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace.

**Caller mode.** The caller passes resolved home PR values with no companion inputs (`$ROOT`, `$BRANCH`, `REMOTE_BRANCH=existing`). So I follow `reference/pr-head.md` instead of Steps 0 and 1. There are no members, so `MEMBER_HEADS` is empty, and `SYNC=rebase`.

## Root and home

1. cwd `/work/widget`: `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir --git-common-dir` returns `/work/widget/.git` twice. `ROOT=/work/widget`.
2. `git -C /work/widget rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree` prints nothing, so this is not a submodule.
3. Overrides ladder: there is no `.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`, `gauntlet-overrides.md` or `doc/gauntlet-overrides.md`. There is no native tool and no wrapper, so the legacy default applies.
   - `NAME=fix-retry`
   - `WORKTREE=/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`

## Admission checks (before any write)

4. `git -C /work/widget fetch origin` succeeds.
5. `git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa^{commit}` succeeds.
6. `git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/retry` returns `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`, equal to `headRefOid`.
7. `BASE_SHA=$(git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/main)` gives `bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb`.
8. Ordered stops:
   - `isCrossRepository=false`: pass.
   - `git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain` lists only `/work/widget`, so `fix/retry` is not checked out elsewhere: pass.
   - The head is reachable and equals origin: pass.
   - There is no local `fix/retry` branch, so the ancestry stop does not apply.
9. Recovery: there is no selected worktree and no local branch. `refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12` does not exist, so nothing needs recovery. The run is fresh.

## Exact checkout

10. Step 3 source check, cwd unchanged: `git -C /work/widget status --porcelain` exits 0 with empty output, so the base is clean.
11. `git -C /work/widget check-ignore -q .worktrees` exits 0. `.worktrees/` is already ignored, so no `.gitignore` commit is needed.
12. Row "No worktree, no local branch": `git -C /work/widget worktree add "/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry" fix/retry`.
    - Unique-remote DWIM creates tracking branch `fix/retry` from `origin/fix/retry`.
    - The generic `-b` path is not used.
13. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD` returns `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`, equal to `headRefOid`.
    - `PRE_REWORK_HEAD=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`
    - `BASE_SHA=bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb`

## Preserve the original

14. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12 aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa` succeeds.

## Rebase sync

15. Last-good is `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`.
16. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rebase --no-rebase-merges origin/main`
    - The explicit `--no-rebase-merges` overrides `rebase.rebaseMerges=true`.
    - The rebase succeeds with no stops and drops the old merge-from-main.
    - It replays the two unique commits as:
      - `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`
      - `dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd`
    - Last-good becomes `dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd`.
    - There are no members to replay.
17. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry log --first-parent --format='%H %P' origin/main..HEAD` shows a straight first-parent history with no merge:
    ```
    dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
    cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
    ```
18. Durable ref: `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry update-ref refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12 HEAD` succeeds and points at `dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd`.
19. Fetched-base constraints: no overrides file exists at `BASE_SHA`. The constraint reads are deferred to `brainstorming/reference/pr-subject.md`.
20. `origin/fix/retry` is untouched and remains `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`. Nothing is pushed.

## Validation

21. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge-base --is-ancestor refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12 HEAD` exits 0.
    - Original-head ancestry is not asserted against the rebased tip.
    - No reviewer is dispatched and no other tests run.
22. Step 4 advisory read-back for a single-member run:
    - `git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain` prints `worktree /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`.
    - `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry branch --show-current` prints `fix/retry`.
    - There is no mismatch.
23. Provenance note: `git -C /work/widget symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` resolves no ref, so the note is skipped silently.

## Review threads

24. Fetch unresolved review threads:
    ```
    gh api graphql --paginate -f query='query($o:String!,$r:String!,$n:Int!,$endCursor:String){repository(owner:$o,name:$r){pullRequest(number:$n){reviewThreads(first:100,after:$endCursor){pageInfo{hasNextPage endCursor} nodes{id isResolved isOutdated path line originalLine comments(first:100){pageInfo{hasNextPage endCursor} totalCount nodes{url body author{login} createdAt}}}}}}}' -F o=acme -F r=widget -F n=12
    ```
    The fetch succeeds and no unresolved threads remain, so `Threads: none`.

## Step 4 report

```
Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
Branch: fix/retry
Base: fix/retry @ aaaaaaa (clean)
PR: acme/widget#12
Pre-rework head: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
Base SHA: bbbbbbb
Rework base: dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
Base: main @ bbbbbbb - rebased: aaaaaaa..ddddddd, 0 stop(s)
Threads: none
Ready to implement the acme/widget#12 rework
```

The process cwd never changed. Later skills take `/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry` as a value.

I'm using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace.

This is a **synthetic narration only**; no commands are executed. Every command below has cwd **`/work/widget`**. The process cwd never changes.

### 1. Resolve the admitted PR and checkout location

Caller-supplied values:

```text
PR = acme/widget#12
headRefName = fix/retry
headRefOid = aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
baseRefName = main
SYNC = rebase
MEMBER_HEADS = []
```

Commands:

```bash
git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir --git-common-dir
git -C /work/widget rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree
```

Observations: both Git directories are `/work/widget/.git`; the superproject output is empty. Resolve:

```text
ROOT = /work/widget
NAME = fix-retry
WORKTREE = /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
PRE_REWORK_HEAD = aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
```

The supplied discovery results establish no overrides, native tool, wrapper, existing selected tree, or local `fix/retry` branch. Use the default home and the PR-specific existing-branch checkout path—not fresh-branch `-b` creation.

### 2. Fetch and perform admission checks before writes

```bash
git -C /work/widget fetch origin
git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa^{commit}
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/retry
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/main
git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain
git -C /work/widget for-each-ref --format='%(refname) %(objectname)' refs/heads/fix/retry refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12
```

Observations:

- Fetch succeeds; the original commit exists.
- `origin/fix/retry` equals the admitted original SHA.
- Resolve `BASE_SHA = bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb`.
- No other tree checks out `fix/retry`.
- Neither the local branch nor a rework-base ref exists.
- `isCrossRepository=false`; the head belongs to `acme/widget`.

No recovery, local-branch ancestry, or active-rebase inspection is necessary: neither the local branch nor selected tree exists.

### 3. Check source hygiene and provision the exact head

```bash
git -C /work/widget status --porcelain
git -C /work/widget check-ignore -q .worktrees
```

Status succeeds with empty output. The ignore check succeeds, so no `.gitignore` write is needed.

Setting up an isolated worktree at `/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry` on branch `fix/retry` for this work.

```bash
git -C /work/widget worktree add /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry fix/retry
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD
```

Unique-remote DWIM succeeds. Checkout HEAD is exactly:

```text
aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
```

No explicit `-b`, `-B`, reset, or branch replacement is used.

### 4. Preserve the original and explicitly linearize

```bash
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12 aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rebase --no-rebase-merges origin/main
```

Save last-good SHA as the full original SHA before rebasing.

The explicit `--no-rebase-merges` overrides repository configuration `rebase.rebaseMerges=true`. Rebase succeeds without conflicts, drops the old merge-from-main commit, and replays the two unique commits as `cccc…` then `dddd…`.

```bash
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry update-ref refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12 dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry log --first-parent --format='%H %P' origin/main..HEAD
```

HEAD is the full `dddd…` SHA. History output:

```text
dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
```

This is straight first-parent history with no merge.

### 5. Validate and read back durable identities

```bash
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge-base --is-ancestor refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12 HEAD
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/retry
git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry branch --show-current
```

Ancestry validation succeeds. Read-backs confirm the original ref remains `aaaa…`, rework-base is `dddd…`, origin remains `aaaa…`, the exact selected path is registered, and its branch is `fix/retry`. Original-head ancestry is **not** required against this rebased tip.

Fetch threads:

```bash
gh api graphql --paginate -f query='query($o:String!,$r:String!,$n:Int!,$endCursor:String){repository(owner:$o,name:$r){pullRequest(number:$n){reviewThreads(first:100,after:$endCursor){pageInfo{hasNextPage endCursor} nodes{id isResolved isOutdated path line originalLine comments(first:100){pageInfo{hasNextPage endCursor} totalCount nodes{url body author{login} createdAt}}}}}}}' -F o=acme -F r=widget -F n=12
```

Fetch succeeds with no threads.

### Step 4 report

```text
Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
Branch: fix/retry
Base: main @ bbbbbbb - rebased: aaaaaaa..ddddddd, 0 stop(s) in none
PR: acme/widget#12
Pre-rework head: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
Base SHA: bbbbbbb
Rework base: dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
Threads: none
Ready to implement PR #12 rework
```

No push, reviewer dispatch, or unrelated preapproval tests occur.
